requirement: A Joomla import blocked by a named firewall (Cloudflare challenge, ModSecurity) is blocked_by_firewall with the firewall named, on any status and any step, not admin_gate or a generic failure

oracle.ref: PR #1525 (fix); fix evidence: Production alert 20/10/2026 on a Joomla site: Reason: admin_gate · Where: login_page/forbidden · HTTP 403 · /administrator, while the server's GET got Cloudflare's challenge (cf-mitigated: challenge) on /administrator/ and on /
oracle.invariant: S1: every named-firewall answer is {ok:false, reason:'blocked_by_firewall', firewall:'cloudflare'|'modsecurity'} with the step's diagnostic (login_page/forbidden, login_page/firewall on the 200, login_post/forbidden, login_landing/server_denied, install_page/server_denied, upload_install, upload_page); the plain 403 with only server: cloudflare stays admin_gate with no firewall; blocked_by_firewall maps to import_error_blocked_by_firewall. The non-403 challenges are blocked_by_firewall with check 'firewall' at login_post/login_page/login_landing/install_page/api_door; the configure page challenge is blocked_by_firewall, not configure_failed/no_token; the controls keep no_redirect, unreachable, a reason other than blocked_by_firewall, and cowork_not_answering. S2: the run ends state error, error 'blocked_by_firewall', errorDetail {firewall:'cloudflare'}, diagnostic {at:'login_page', check:'forbidden', status:403}, and one log line 'blocked by cloudflare at signing_in'. S3: the run ends state error, error 'blocked_by_firewall', errorDetail {firewall:'cloudflare'}, diagnostic at api_door check firewall, no credential registered.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
